title: Review findings
description: One reviewer's findings (plans/full-pipeline.md, step 7). Each is checked by the verifier before anything is changed.

id.description: Your own short ID, e.g. F1.

file.description: Repo path the finding is about.

claim.description: What is wrong, in one or two sentences.

evidence.description: Code quoted from the diff or tree, a concrete input or sequence of steps, or the screenshot and mockup compared.

checked.description: Optional: what you checked and how, findings or not, so an empty list of findings is auditable.

target.description: The item, file, function, selector or hunk you checked.

how.description: How: the Grep and what it found, the trace, the gate or test that runs it.
